authorization: Researcher explicitly requests an attempt to prove general L->infinity thermodynamic-limit statements.
scope: Independent bounded U(1) currents, known fixed arrows, perfect interior integer charges, inherited rough boundaries, binary logical score and optimal inference. Fixed p,q as L grows. Entropy-density existence additionally assumes periodic bulk arrow patterns and regular boxes.
candidate_theorems: On bounded-degree patch families with polynomial rough-boundary count and linear separation, the connected-current path criterion gives exponential Bayes correctability under edge-cost convexity and subcritical weighted path growth.
A parity-only minimum-weight rule yields a direction-independent criterion using 2*sqrt(p*(1-p)); complementing the known all-active pattern covers high p.

Combining those criteria with the honeycomb connective constant proves uniform-in-p exponential correctability for a fixed open bias interval q>qstar or q<1-qstar, qstar=(1+sqrt(1-(3-2*sqrt(2))^2))/2. Check convexity and the high-p join analytically; do not extrapolate the q=1 gauge transform.

For periodic bulk arrows, the disorder-averaged normalized evidence free-energy density has an entropy-density limit. The dominant and posterior-selected logical-sector free-energy densities share it, since the logical contribution is bounded by log(2).
Correctability is equivalent to divergence in probability of the absolute sector gap and to vanishing binary conditional entropy; a bulk pressure alone does not determine either.
acceptance: Give complete proofs and distinguish prior theorems from new extensions.
Verify the algebraic bias interval and strict margins using exact radical arithmetic or rational certificates; a floating grid is a check, not the proof.
Exhaustive square L3 controls check parity-complement inference and entropy/free-energy identities at p=.05,.30,.50,.80,.95 and q=.5,.9,.995,1; preserve posterior ties and endpoints separately.
Recheck canonical honeycomb path geometry from existing source and retain boundary growth and separation assumptions explicitly.
Record what is unresolved: necessity outside sufficient regions, general square criticality, physical CFT, and almost-sure free-energy limits unless separately proved.
Update plan, proofs, report, registry, loop state and the exact rendered current document.
unrelated_project_state_preserved: Lab 005 J6 pilot closed censored after 272 histories and 2176 rows, with zero bootstraps. Its next prerequisite is a deterministic causal odd-syndrome/time-boundary handoff matrix, not reinterpretation of that pilot.
decision: Proved the stated sufficient thermodynamic criteria, a strict fixed honeycomb bias window with uniform-in-p exponential correctability, sector-gap/entropy equivalences and averaged bulk free-energy-density existence under periodic bulk arrows. This is not a full phase classification or a square threshold result.
